rationale: Price is currently testing the confluence of session VWAP ($15.28) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($15.29), which have caught up to the consolidation following the morning gap. Although the most recent 1-minute bar showed an uptick in selling volume, the broader thesis of holding above VWAP and the $15.24 invalidation level remains structurally intact in the upper quartile of today's range. We maintain the long position to allow the VWAP test to resolve while the stop-loss protects against a deeper breakdown.
